title: Haunted
description: This mod adds a new game mechanics to Minecraft - blocks which act as entities. Using the Potion of Haunting provided by this mod, venture into this new world where sentient block entities.
body:
# Haunted: Bring Your Blocks to Life

This mod adds a new potion to minecraft. This potion, Potion of Haunting, imbues some functional blocks with life, binding them to their owner, the one who throwed the potion onto them. This makes their owner able to command them to automate certain tasks like crafting, smelting, brewing, etc.

## Potion of Haunting
This potion doesn't seem to do anything when you throw it on a block. However, when a player throws this potion on a functional block like a crafting table, the crafting table converts into a live entity, wandering on its own.

More features coming soon...
